defmodule MyApp.Rejects do
  alias MyApp.Admission

  @spec run([term()]) :: [MyApp.Admission.admit()]
  @type admit :: MyApp.Admission.admit()

  def run(xs) do
    Enum.map(xs, &MyApp.Admission.admit/1)
  end

  def run_args(xs) do
    Enum.map(xs, &MyApp.Admission.admit(&1))
  end

  defmacro build(x) do
    quote do
      MyApp.Admission.admit(unquote(x))
    end
  end

  def mixed(xs), do: {Other.Gate.admit(xs), Enum.map(xs, &Admission.admit/1)}

  def one(x), do: MyApp.Admission.admit(x); def two(x), do: MyApp.Admission.admit(x)

  def genuine(x), do: MyApp.Admission.admit(x)
end
